 Coram : Manish Pitale And

By this writ petition, the petitioner challenges notice dated 1st November 2022 issued under Section 38 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, whereby possession of the subject land was threatened to be taken from the petitioner.

sentences.text: 2. It is submitted that during the pendency of this petition, the possession was taken.
